svg.title: Results at a glance
svg.desc: Results at a glance. The real placement of cell types costs 0.459 times the wire of random placements of the same positions, 0.728 times when positions are shuffled only within brain or nerve cord, and cost-reducing swaps still cut at least 33.6%. The 7.5% of connections that cross the neck hold 24.0% of the wire. Cutting them removes 0.36 times the sensory-to-motor flow that random wiring of the same length removes, and 1.83 times for flow from brain to nerve cord. Rich-to-rich routes through the connective are 1.103 times the rewired mean, and 1.002 times at a 0.5% edge threshold.
